what_this_is: DATA for do-work/pieces.mjs and do-work/piece-sweep.mjs, and for the two piece rows (do-work/split-a-document-into-pieces.mjs, do-work/check-every-piece-is-covered.mjs). A piece is a row of the person's one Checks list (list:checks, records `record_prefix`<id> of type `check_type`) whose `kind_field` is `piece_kind`; the coverage row reads them with the door's where on that field, then reads each check row a piece names, one by one. `no_file`: the file a piece with no source counts under. `words`: every line and refusal, {name} filled from the answer.

words.file: {file}: {pieces} pieces, {with_check} with a check, {with_reason} with a recorded reason, {uncovered} uncovered
words.uncovered: Uncovered in {file}: {id} ({section}) has no check and no reason. Write a check row and name it in checked_by, or record no_check: { reason, covered_by }.
words.missing_check: {piece} names the check {check} in checked_by, which is not a row of list:checks.
words.missing_covered_by: {piece} names {check} in no_check.covered_by, which is not a row of list:checks.
words.no_pieces: The person has no piece rows (record:check rows with kind piece); split their documents into pieces first with tool:split-a-document-into-pieces.
words.text: Send text: the words of the document to split, as a string.
words.file_name: file, when sent, is the document's name, as a string.
